NPLEX Part I Competencies

Built on the NABNE Part I blueprint and written to USMLE Step 1 depth. Each blueprint unit lists what you should be able to do, tagged by where it comes from.

    Where each competency comes from

    • NPLEX Required by the NPLEX blueprint
    • NPLEX + USMLE On both outlines
    • USMLE extension Step 1 topic added inside the closest NPLEX unit

      USMLE Step 1 crosswalk

      About this list

      NPLEX source. NABNE, NPLEX Part I Biomedical Sciences Study Guide, revised March 2026, for the August 2026 administrations. Open the study guide.

      USMLE source. USMLE Step 1 Content Outline and Specifications. Open the specifications. USMLE removed its General Principles section, so foundational science sits inside each organ system here too.

      Not included. Pharmacology, behavioral and social sciences, biostatistics and epidemiology, and care of the well patient. NPLEX Part I does not test them. A drug appears only when it causes a listed condition.

      Codes. Unit codes come from the blueprint (CV-7, CV-18-C). Competency codes add a number (CV-7.3). Condition codes add a digit to the category (CV-18-C3 is myocardial infarction).

      Added by MedMasters, not NABNE. Unit short names, exam-area tags, depth (DOK) levels, the USMLE extensions, and the crosswalk. Each question still carries its own exam area.
